topic: Site not found by new buyers in search
problem: The website shows up when people search the brand name, but buyers who do not know the brand yet never find it when they search for the product.
solution: The MarketOps SEO team finds what new buyers search for, builds pages that match those searches, fixes the issues that stop pages from ranking, and tracks new visitors from search every month.
title: New buyers can't find my site in search
line: MarketOps SEO. Found by new buyers.

topic: Ads abroad reaching the wrong buyers
problem: The seller runs ads in another country, but they reach people who are unlikely to buy, so money is spent with few sales.
solution: The MarketOps Overseas Growth team picks the right country first, targets buyers who fit the product, cuts spend that is not turning into sales, and matches each ad to a local listing.
title: My ads abroad reach the wrong buyers
items: We cut spend that won't sell
line: MarketOps Overseas Growth. Aimed at the right buyers.

topic: Product images that do not explain the product
problem: Shoppers cannot tell from the images what the product does, how big it is or why it is better, so they scroll past.
solution: The MarketOps Creative Studio team shows the product in use, adds size and detail shots, puts key features on the images, and designs every image to read clearly on a phone screen.
title: My product images don't explain the product
items: We show the product in use
We add size and detail shots
line: MarketOps Creative Studio. Clear at a glance.
